Corp draws 1 card from the basic draw action
Corp installs Project Beale in a new remote

Corp installs Breaker Bay Grid in a new remote
game.cards.basic-test/corp-basic-actions.nativeTitle: installing an upgrade in a new remote creates that server (CR 4.6.8b)
game.cards.basic-test/corp-basic-actions.reason: The port exposed that an upgrade install could not create a remote server. CR 4.6.8b creates a remote by declaring it the destination for a card about to be installed, and CR 4.6.5a installs upgrades in the root of any server. The engine fix carries the native regression test named here; this port keeps the Breaker Bay Grid board.

Hedge Fund raises Corp credits by 4 after its play cost
Corp places 1 advancement counter on Ice Wall
Corp places 1 advancement counter on Project Beale
Corp trashes Fan Site while the Runner is tagged
Corp purges virus counters, trashing Clot, and Botulus regains 1 counter next turn
game.cards.basic-test/corp-basic-actions.reason: Botulus names its host ice as the install destination in this engine; upstream installs it and answers a host prompt afterward. The installed board and purge outcome are unchanged.

titles: A run on R&D with an empty deck ends with nothing to access
Runner accesses the top card of R&D and takes no action
Runner accesses an unrezzed upgrade in the root of R&D and declines to trash it
Runner accesses a card from R&D and then the upgrade in its root
The Maker's Eye accesses 3 cards from R&D and steals the agendas among them
game.core.access-test/rd-access.reason: The Maker's Eye supplies the additional R&D accesses; upstream adds them with its internal access-bonus helper. The multiple-upgrades candidate-ordering block and the Ganked!/Ansel 1.0 forced-encounter loop wait for a later batch.

titles: A run on HQ with an empty hand ends with nothing to access
Runner accesses a card from HQ and takes no action
Runner accesses an unrezzed upgrade in the root of HQ and declines to trash it
Runner accesses two unrezzed upgrades in the root of HQ in turn
Runner accesses a card from HQ and then the upgrade in its root
Runner pays 5 credits to trash Bryan Stinson as the only card accessed from HQ
game.core.access-test/hq-access.reason: The single-card board empties HQ by playing the drawn Hedge Fund; upstream restricts the access with its internal set-only-card-to-access helper. The Ganked!/Ansel 1.0 forced-encounter loop waits for a later batch.

titles: A run on empty Archives ends with nothing to access
Runner accesses non-interactive cards in Archives and the run ends
Runner steals an agenda from Archives for 1 agenda point
Runner steals two agendas from Archives for 2 agenda points
Corp may purge when Cyberdex Virus Suite is accessed from Archives
Runner takes 1 net damage from Shock! in Archives and answers the Cyberdex Virus Suite choice
Runner accesses Cyberdex Virus Suite and then steals Hostile Takeover from Archives
Runner steals three copies of Breaking News from Archives
Runner accesses the faceup cards in Archives and steals Global Food Initiative
game.core.access-test/archives-access.reason: Shock! damage applies on access in this engine; upstream offers the Corp a prompt first. The access-count-reduced blocks drive the internal access-bonus helper, the facedown mid-access block rewrites card state mid-access, and the Ganked!/Ansel 1.0 loop waits for a later batch.

titles: Imp spends a hosted virus counter to trash Mumbad Virtual Tour on access
game.core.access-test/multiple-trash-abi.reason: The Imp trash arrives as a mid-access choice here; upstream picks it from a prompt list. The Cupellation and two-Imp blocks wait for a later batch.
